```{r}
# Practical Course on Analysing the Diversity of Microbial Eukaryotes in Environments, October 2026, Urwitałt, Poland
# Małgorzata Chwalińska and Marta Sałek


library("phyloseq")
library("readxl")
library("dplyr")
library("tidyverse")
library("vegan")
library("ggplot2")
library("ggsignif")
library("UpSetR")
```

Importing file and creating phyloseq object
```{r}
table <- read_excel("otu_table.xlsx")
taxonomy <- read_excel("taxonomy_table.xlsx")
samples <-  read_excel("sample_table.xlsx")


table <- table %>%
  column_to_rownames("OTU")
taxonomy <- taxonomy %>%
  column_to_rownames("OTU")
samples <- samples %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")

table <- as.matrix(table)
taxonomy <- as.matrix(taxonomy)

ASV = otu_table(table, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX = tax_table(taxonomy)
SAM = sample_data(samples)
TREE = read_tree("fasttree_otus_rooted.tre") # If the tree is available
  
phylo_obj <- phyloseq(ASV, TAX, SAM, TREE) # If the tree is available
#phylo_obj <- phyloseq(ASV, TAX, SAM)
phylo_obj

```

Filtering sequences
```{r}
# Filtering sequences with abundance less than 10 in all samples
phylo_obj <- filter_taxa(phylo_obj, function(x) sum(x) >= 10, TRUE)

# Extracting only eukaryotic sequences
phylo_obj <- subset_taxa(phylo_obj, Domain %in% c("Eukaryota"))
```

Barplots
```{r}
# Changing abundances to relative abundances
phylo_obj_pc <- transform_sample_counts(phylo_obj, function(x) x / sum(x))

plot_bar(phylo_obj_pc, fill = "Subdivision", facet_grid=~zone) +
  geom_bar(aes(color=Subdivision, fill=Subdivision), stat="identity", position="stack")+
  theme(legend.title=element_blank())+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#ee0148", "#14aaff", "#b52b00", "#a8dbf0", "#b009d1", "#c6e000", "#0159f2", "#ff8e4d", "#016d59", "#ff7071", "#3c5ca3", "#01d761", "#cb009a", "#8ee4c5", "#6f5b39", "#40ecc6", "#ff00a1", "#c3dd81", "#91407c", "#1eefa9", "#af8900", "#d0b9ff", "#006f2c", "#f6d04b", "#4c616b")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#ee0148", "#14aaff", "#b52b00", "#a8dbf0", "#b009d1", "#c6e000", "#0159f2", "#ff8e4d", "#016d59", "#ff7071", "#3c5ca3", "#01d761", "#cb009a", "#8ee4c5", "#6f5b39", "#40ecc6", "#ff00a1", "#c3dd81", "#91407c", "#1eefa9", "#af8900", "#d0b9ff", "#006f2c", "#f6d04b", "#4c616b")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.key.size = unit(2, 'mm')) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 270))
ggsave("barplots_euk.png", plot = last_plot())
```

Rarefaction curve
```{r}
# Preparing OTU table to calculate rarefaction curve
tab <- otu_table(phylo_obj)
class(tab) <- "matrix"
tab <- t(tab)

# Calculating rarefaction curve
png(file = "rarecurve.png", width=1200, height=700)
rare <- rarecurve(tab, step=1000, lwd=2, ylab="OTU",  label=T)
dev.off()
```

Alpha diversity
```{r}
# Alpha diversity for samples without rarefaction
plot_richness(phylo_obj)

# Alpha diversity for samples after rarefaction
plot_richness(phylo_obj_rarefied)

# Correlation of alpha diversity index with number of reads
reads <- sample_sums(phylo_obj)

alpha <- estimate_richness(phylo_obj, measures = "Observed")
cor.test(reads, alpha$Observed, method = "spearman")

alpha <- estimate_richness(phylo_obj, measures = "Shannon")
cor.test(reads, alpha$Shannon, method = "spearman")

alpha <- estimate_richness(phylo_obj, measures = "Simpson")
cor.test(reads, alpha$Simpson, method = "spearman")

# Plotting groups and checking if number of reads are different within groups 
sample_data(phylo_obj)$Reads <- sample_sums(phylo_obj)
wilcox.test(Reads ~ zone,
            data = data.frame(sample_data(phylo_obj)))
pr = plot_richness(phylo_obj, x="zone", color ="zone", measures = c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson"))
pr + geom_boxplot() + geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("photic", "aphotic")), test=wilcox.test, map_signif_level = TRUE)
ggsave("alpha_groups.png", plot = last_plot())
```

Upset plot
```{r}
# Transform counts to presence/absence
phylo_obj_pa <- transform_sample_counts(phylo_obj, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))
otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phylo_obj_pa))
if (!taxa_are_rows(phylo_obj_pa)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}
# Extract groups
metadata <- as.data.frame(sample_data(phylo_obj_pa))
groups <- metadata$zone
# Create presence/absence by group
otu_group <- sapply(unique(groups), function(g) {
  rowSums(otu[, groups == g, drop = FALSE]) > 0
})
# Convert TRUE/FALSE to 1/0
otu_group <- as.data.frame(otu_group * 1)
head(otu_group)
# Plot
png(file = "upset.png", width=1200, height=700)
upset(
  otu_group,
  sets = colnames(otu_group),
  order.by = "freq",
  sets.bar.color = "steelblue",
  main.bar.color = "darkred",
  number.angles = 30,
  text.scale = 2
)
dev.off()
```

Beta diversity and ordination
```{r}
### Calculating PCoA for three diversity indices ###
bray <- ordinate(phylo_obj, "PCoA", "bray")
plot_ordination(phylo_obj, bray, color="zone", shape = "lake") +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = zone, group = zone), type = "t", level = 0.95)+
  theme_minimal()
ggsave('plots/bray_pcoa.png', plot = last_plot())

jaccard <- ordinate(phylo_obj, "PCoA", "jaccard")
plot_ordination(phylo_obj, jaccard, color="zone", shape = "lake") +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = zone, group = zone), type = "t", level = 0.95)+

wunif <- ordinate(phylo_obj, "PCoA", "wunifrac") # Do only when sequence tree was uploaded

### Calculation dendrogram based on one index ###
otu <- as(otu_table(phylo_obj), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(phylo_obj)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}
bray <- vegdist(otu,  method = "bray")

# Hierarchical clustering
hclust_result <- hclust(bray, method = "average")

png(file = "dendrogram_bray.png", width=1200, height=700)
plot(hclust_result, 
     main = "Bray-Curtis dissimilarity dendrogram",
     xlab = "", 
     ylab = "Bray-Curtis dissimilarity",
     sub = "")
dev.off()

### NMDS - stress plot and three beta diversity indices ###
# Calculate diversity index
otu <- as(otu_table(phylo_obj), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(phylo_obj)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}
bray <- vegdist(otu,  method = "bray")

# Define a function NMDS.scree() that automatically performs a NMDS for 1-5 dimensions and plots the nr of dimensions vs the stress
NMDS.scree <- function(x) { #where x is the name of the data frame variable
  plot(rep(1, 5), replicate(5, metaMDS(x, autotransform = F, k = 1)$stress), xlim = c(1, 5),ylim = c(0, 0.30), xlab = "# of Dimensions", ylab = "Stress", main = "NMDS stress plot")
  for (i in 1:5) {
    points(rep(i + 1,5),replicate(5, metaMDS(x, autotransform = F, k = i + 1)$stress))
  }
}

# Run the function
png(file = "stress_plot_nmds.png", width=1200, height=700)
NMDS.scree(bray)
dev.off()

# Calculate and plot NMDS for preferred number of dimensions
bray <- ordinate(phylo_obj, "NMDS", "bray", k = 3)
plot_ordination(phylo_obj, bray, color="zone", shape = "lake") +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = zone, group = zone), type = "t", level = 0.95)+
  theme_minimal()
ggsave('bray_nmds.png', plot = last_plot())
```

```{r}
# Extract OTU table
otu <- as(otu_table(phylo_obj), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(phylo_obj)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

# Extract metadata
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(phylo_obj))
meta <- meta %>%
  select(zone, lake, trophy, PPO4, PT, NNH4, Cl, temp, oxy) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
meta$PPO4 <- as.numeric(meta$PPO4)
meta$PT <- as.numeric(meta$PT)
meta$NNH4 <- as.numeric(meta$NNH4)
meta$Cl <- as.numeric(meta$Cl)
meta$temp <- as.numeric(meta$temp)
meta$oxy <- as.numeric(meta$oxy)

# Perform CCA with selected environmental variables
cca_result <- cca(otu ~ trophy + PPO4 + PT + NNH4 + Cl + temp + oxy, data = meta)

# Check important variables
cca_selected <- ordistep(cca_result, scope = formula(cca_result),direction = "forward",permutations = 999)

# Rerun CCA
cca_result <- cca(otu ~ PPO4 + NNH4 + temp + oxy, data = meta)

# Check multicollinearity between your environmental variables
vif.cca(cca_result)

# Rerun CCA
cca_result <- cca(otu ~ PPO4 + NNH4 + oxy, data = meta)

# Extract scores
site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(cca_result, display = "sites"))
site_scores$SampleID <- rownames(site_scores)

# Add metadata
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(phylo_obj))
site_scores <- cbind(site_scores, meta)

# Extract biplot arrows (environmental variables)
env_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(cca_result, display = "bp"))
env_scores$variable <- rownames(env_scores)
env_scores <- env_scores %>%
  filter(!grepl("lake", variable, ignore.case = TRUE))

# Extract species scores
sp_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(cca_result, display = "species"))

# Plot
ggplot() +
  # Sample points
  geom_point(data = site_scores, aes(x = CCA1, y = CCA2, color = meta$lake, shape = meta$zone), size = 3) +
  # Environmental arrows
  geom_segment(data = env_scores,aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CCA1, yend = CCA2),arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")),color = "red") +
  # Species points
  geom_point(data = sp_scores,aes(x = CCA1, y = CCA2),shape = 3, color = "grey50", size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  # Arrow labels
  geom_text(data = env_scores,aes(x = CCA1 * 1.1, y = CCA2 * 1.1, label = variable), color = "red", size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "CCA", x = "CCA1", y = "CCA2")
ggsave('cca.png', plot = last_plot())

### Check most infulential OTU ###
# Extract species scores
sp_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(cca_result, display = "species"))
sp_scores$taxa <- rownames(sp_scores)

# Calculate distance from origin — further = more influential
sp_scores$distance <- sqrt(sp_scores$CCA1^2 + sp_scores$CCA2^2)

# Keep only top N most influential taxa
top_n <- 5  # adjust this number as needed
sp_scores_top <- sp_scores %>%
  arrange(desc(distance)) %>%
  slice(1:top_n)

ggplot() +
  # Sample points
  geom_point(data = site_scores, aes(x = CCA1, y = CCA2, color = meta$lake, shape = meta$zone), size = 3) +
  # Environmental arrows
  geom_segment(data = env_scores,aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CCA1, yend = CCA2),arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")), color = "red") +
  # Arrow labels
  geom_text(data = env_scores,aes(x = CCA1 * 1.1, y = CCA2 * 1.1, label = variable),color = "red", size = 3) +
  # All species points
  geom_point(data = sp_scores,aes(x = CCA1, y = CCA2),shape = 3, color = "grey80", size = 1, alpha = 0.3) +
  # Top species points
  geom_point(data = sp_scores_top,aes(x = CCA1, y = CCA2),shape = 3, color = "grey30", size = 2) +
  # Top species labels — nudge to avoid overlapping points
  geom_text(data = sp_scores_top,aes(x = CCA1, y = CCA2, label = taxa),color = "grey30", nudge_y = 0.05, size = 2.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "CCA", x = "CCA1", y = "CCA2")
ggsave('cca2.png', plot = last_plot())
```

```{r}
# Test whether each environmental variable significantly explains community composition
env_anova <- anova.cca(cca_result, by = "margin", permutations = 999)

# Barplots of contributions to variation
sig_env <- rownames(env_anova)[env_anova$`Pr(>F)` <= 0.05]
env_scores <- scores(cca_result, display = "bp", scaling = 2)
env_lengths <- sqrt(rowSums(env_scores^2))
total_inertia       <- cca_result$tot.chi
constrained_inertia <- cca_result$CCA$tot.chi
residual_inertia    <- total_inertia - constrained_inertia
env_percent <- (env_lengths^2 / sum(env_lengths^2)) * (constrained_inertia / total_inertia) * 100
df_env <- data.frame( Factor  = rownames(env_scores),Percent = env_percent,
  Sig     = ifelse(rownames(env_scores) %in% sig_env,"Significant", "Non-significant"))
df_resid <- data.frame(Factor  = "Residual",Percent = (residual_inertia / total_inertia) * 100,Sig = "Residual")
df_plot <- rbind(df_env, df_resid)
df_plot <- df_plot |> dplyr::arrange(desc(Percent))
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = reorder(Factor, Percent), y = Percent, fill = Sig)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percent, 1), "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Significant"= "steelblue","Non-significant" = "grey70","Residual" = "grey40")) +
  labs(x = "Environmental Factor", y = "Percentage of total inertia (%)",
    title = "Contr of Env Factors and Residuals", fill = "Term type" ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0,80) +
  theme( plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 12),axis.title   = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),legend.text  = element_text(size = 11))
ggsave('barplot_cca_variation.png', plot = last_plot())
```
